statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual self-assessment with outside review every second year
Annual policy review; time-limited exceptions
No subcontracted administration without city approval; FAR 52.204-21 flow-down
Complete the city and GSA annual courses
Customer data only in approved services
Provider checklist before a new service
Annual review of the suite provider SOC 2 report
Parts check and SAM.gov FASCSA search before federal building purchases
Owner-watched remote support; no unattended access
Personal accounts; written request for named accounts in customer systems
MFA wherever offered
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (IA-2(1); MFA for remote access)

statement_summary: Unique passphrases in a password manager; defaults changed
Remote access to customer systems only through the approved path
Standard account for daily work
Sealed emergency access envelope; second authenticator
Monthly review of audit trail, session log, and sign-ins
Quarterly account list to the city IT manager
Report a lost PIV card immediately; return at subcontract end
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Three-level data classification
Full-disk encryption on every device
Sharing only to named people; CUI only to the prime and GSA
CUI only in the restricted folder and locked cabinet; mark excerpts
Nightly and monthly backups of controller programs; quarterly comparison
Keep two cardholder exports; contract-end transfer and destruction
Shredding; device wipe or certified destruction with a record
Public records requests go to the city custodian
Laptop never on a GSA network; city network only through the VPN
regulatory_driver: C-GOVERNMENT-R01 (GSA rules of behavior); CT-C security exhibit (AC-20)

statement_summary: Approved software sources; updates and antivirus on; encrypted drives only
No customer data in services outside Appendix A
No customer data in AI tools; AI features in customer systems only after P10 and a customer decision
Separate work network at home
CUI and administrator training
regulatory_driver: CT-F 32 CFR Part 2002; CT-C security exhibit (AT-3)

statement_summary: Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Meet the city, prime, FAR, and Florida notice clocks
regulatory_driver: CT-C 24-hour notice; C-GOVERNMENT-R01 (BTTRG 1.6.1); CT-F FAR 52.204-25(d); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a)

statement_summary: Building safety first in an incident
No ransom for customer systems; OFAC check for any payment
Backup controls firm approved by the city
Manual operation sheet per building; annual walkthrough
